title: Whoop always on
description: A black band with a big light heading and a step-by-step story. On desktop, a list of step titles on the left (the inactive ones dimmed to 40%) where the current step opens its paragraph over a thin line that fills while it plays, then hands over to the next on its own; a square photo on the right crossfades with each step. On phones the photo sits on top and the steps become translucent rounded cards in a snapping track with dots, the photo following the current card.
notes: the band is black in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
steps advance every few seconds on desktop while the block is in view; never under reduced motion
name: whoop-always-on

props.name: interval
props.description: how long each step plays on desktop before the next opens, in milliseconds

props.name: labels
props.description: screen-reader labels of the phone track and its dots ("Show step" → "Show step 2")
